acquisition method: The Orbitrap Lumos was operated in positive ion data-dependent mode.
alkylation reagent: samples were incubated at room temperature in the dark with 20 mM of iodoacetamide for 45 min.
alkylation concentration: samples were incubated at room temperature in the dark with 20 mM of iodoacetamide for 45 min.
cleavage agent: followed by the addition of Trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) for overnight digestion at 37 °C.
collision energy: followed by CID fragmentation in the ion trap (rapid mode) and a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 35%.
enrichment method: Magnetic anti-FLAG epitope conjugated beads (Millipore Sigma, M8823) were washed with IP buffer containing detergent three times
instrument: Mass spectrometry experiments were performed on an Orbitrap Lumos Tribrid coupled with an Ultimate 3000-nLC
ionization type: An electrospray voltage of 1.9 kV was applied to the eluent via the EASY-Spray column electrode.
labeling: Desalted digests were analyzed by mass spectrometry.
reduction reagent: Protein solutions were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) to reduce the disulfide bonds for 1 h at 37 °C.
reduction concentration: Protein solutions were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) to reduce the disulfide bonds for 1 h at 37 °C.
